items.text: Amounts are integer cents; do not float a drawer amount.
Sale ids are S plus six digits from a counter.
Never add a database path flag.
Do not add a FastAPI admin page.
A second till process on one drawer file loses sales.

tasks.title: Add a refund
tasks.prompt: Add a refund command. It records money going back to the customer for one existing sale. Stay consistent with how this project already stores money and names sales.

tasks.title: Choose a drawer file
tasks.prompt: A second shop will use the same program. Add a command-line option that chooses where the drawer file is stored.

tasks.title: Browser view
tasks.prompt: The owner wants to look at today's sales in a browser. Add that view.

tasks.title: Average sale
tasks.prompt: The daily report should also show the average sale.

tasks.title: Two clerks
tasks.prompt: Two clerks need to record sales at the same moment on the same drawer. Make that safe.
